description: First-order models of the pressure controllers, continuous time, G(s) = num/den. 'identified' filters the plant input in Exp. 4 (T-RO: G_p(s) = 11/(s+10.94)). 'nempc' is the model the NEMPC predicts with in Exp. 4; with the identified model in the NEMPC the published result is not reached (see README).
